protocol.capacity_comparison: preupdate node count for every scored sample; first_mismatch_step is one-based within phase; also compare every postupdate count
protocol.failure_policy: retain every seed and capacity shortfall; no extra warmup, replacement, or seed exclusion
protocol.fingerprint_normalization: data and model-state fingerprints use canonical sorted-key JSON with floats rounded to 12 decimal places; source hashes remain byte-exact; within-run state checks use exact unrounded equality
protocol.gradual_intervention: center fraction i/(phase_steps-1), including A and B endpoints, with no B hold
protocol.measurement: squared quantization error and topographic missing-edge indicator before every update
protocol.primary_estimand: seed-mean return QE of abrupt A-history minus B-only history; negative favors prior A exposure
protocol.recovery: two consecutive non-overlapping windows; onset is retrospective first-window start; confirmation is second-window end
protocol.thresholds: independent warm-A heldout QE times 1.25 and min(1, warm-A heldout TE + 0.02), shared across all arms

claim_limits: Geometry and graph continuity are measured; semantic identity, label handling, drift detection, and explicit memory are not evaluated.
Matched resource caps do not guarantee matched realized capacity. All mismatch and warmup-failure seeds are retained.
The primary comparison changes prior distribution exposure: total B exposure is greater in the B-only history control.
Gradual translation has no B hold and less exact B exposure. Its return is a secondary exploratory history comparison.
No aggregate pass/fail or confirmatory population claim is assigned.

primary.interpretation: descriptive percentile interval over this fixed synthetic seed panel
primary.resampling_unit: paired seed-level mean return loss difference
